confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not based on inspected listings or live prices. Restaurant anchors are moderately confident for a small Bolivian tourist town. Accommodation is less certain, especially hotel_3star_2p, since Uyuni has few ordinary three-star options and July is peak dry-season tour season. Cocktail and wine are set at about 2x the beer anchor because direct knowledge of local bar and wine prices is weak.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general price levels in Bolivian highland tourist towns (Potosí, Tupiza, and La Paz tourist districts), scaled down for Uyuni's remote location and tour-driven demand. Accommodation reflects in-season July rates for Salar de Uyuni visitors.
